expectations.text: Keeps the accompanying asset kit deliberately minimal (photos, a presentation template, one contact-request email) rather than a sprawling toolkit
expectations.evidence: The transcript never defines an accompanying asset kit, and it mentions neither a presentation template nor a contact-request email. Photos appear only as part of the Silvers' recap email. The plan does favor lean instruments: 'Intake form + one checklist email' for the Silvers, and calls for only two sponsors. That leanness concerns how sponsors are onboarded, though, not a minimal asset kit with the listed components. At most there is a faint partial overlap, so the score stays low.
